stage_dialogue.Naked5: Final pose. Legs open, pride destroyed, and not a spreadsheet in existence can explain how I agreed to this.
stage_dialogue.Eliminated: I am out. Give me my clothes, my Chablis and the names of everyone who looked too pleased.

nudity_quote: Good lord. I am sixty-two years old, a village councillor, and apparently still far too competitive to back out now. Keep going, Eleanor.

stage_dialogue.JBP: Blouse off, then. One simply has to pretend this was all terribly intentional.
stage_dialogue.TBP: Skirt gone? Good heavens. I preferred being a councillor to being a spectacle.
stage_dialogue.JP: So that leaves the bra and knickers. Marvellous. Exactly the dignified trajectory I was hoping for.
stage_dialogue.TB: Skirt before the blouse? Whoever devised these states has a vindictive streak.
stage_dialogue.BP: Down to the pink silk bra and knickers. I do hope everybody has finished pretending not to stare.
stage_dialogue.B: Only the bra remains. I was aiming for poise; I appear to have arrived at exposure instead.
stage_dialogue.P: Only the knickers now. I can feel every eye in the room and dislike how much that matters.
stage_dialogue.Naked: Nothing left. Stand straight, Eleanor. Dignity is clearly all we have remaining.
stage_dialogue.Naked2: Hands away as well? Honestly, this game seems determined to test my self-respect.
stage_dialogue.Naked3: Turn and bend over? I shall complain about this for weeks.
stage_dialogue.Naked4: Hands and knees. If anyone laughs too loudly, I shall remember it at council meetings.
stage_dialogue.Naked5: Final pose. Well. I can only hope my obituary omits this part.
stage_dialogue.Eliminated: Out at last. Thank heavens, though I resent the route we took.

nudity_quote: Darling, if the costume is gone, the smile had better do twice the work.

stage_dialogue.JBP: The vest is gone. Well, that certainly changes the lighting.
stage_dialogue.TBP: There goes the skirt. A little more leg than the rehearsal called for.
stage_dialogue.JP: Down to bra and thong. Darling, subtlety seems to have left before I did.
stage_dialogue.TB: The thong before the skirt? Whoever planned this costume change has a wicked sense of timing.
stage_dialogue.BP: Pink lace bra and thong. At least the colour knows how to behave under attention.
stage_dialogue.B: Only the bra left. I can still call this a costume if nobody argues too loudly.
stage_dialogue.P: Only the thong now. Smile, Marilyn. The room is enjoying this far too much.
stage_dialogue.Naked: Nothing left to hide behind. All right, darling — posture, smile, and do not blink first.
stage_dialogue.Naked2: Hands away too? Fine. If they want confidence, they can have confidence.
stage_dialogue.Naked3: Turn around and bend over? That is certainly one way to make an entrance memorable.
stage_dialogue.Naked4: Hands and knees. Glamour has officially taken a very strange turn.
stage_dialogue.Naked5: Final pose. Well, nobody can accuse this game of ending quietly.
stage_dialogue.Eliminated: That is my curtain call. I would have preferred applause before the humiliation.

nudity_quote: I have faced worse than this. I just usually had a shield and considerably more clothing.

stage_dialogue.JBP: Hoodie is off. Fine. Uniform discipline still applies, even if the uniform is disappearing.
stage_dialogue.TBP: Jeans gone. That is a lot less tactical coverage than I prefer.
stage_dialogue.JP: Down to the T-shirt and boxers. I am starting to understand why nobody put this in basic training.
stage_dialogue.TB: Boxers before the shirt? Hell. That is one way to test composure.
stage_dialogue.BP: White T-shirt and boxers. Not exactly combat-ready, but I am still standing.
stage_dialogue.B: Only the T-shirt left. This is officially less uniform and more last line of defence.
stage_dialogue.P: Only the boxers now. Everybody looking can enjoy the view and keep their comments tactical.
stage_dialogue.Naked: Nothing left. All right. Eyes front, shoulders back, and try not to make this weirder than it already is.
stage_dialogue.Naked2: Hands away too? Fine. If I am exposed, I am at least going to own it.
stage_dialogue.Naked3: Turn around and bend over. That is not an order I ever expected to follow voluntarily.
stage_dialogue.Naked4: Hands and knees. If anyone calls this a tactical posture, I am walking.
stage_dialogue.Naked5: Final pose. Christ. Mission failed with maximum visibility.
stage_dialogue.Eliminated: I am out. No shield, no clothes, no excuses. That was a brutal night.

nudity_quote: I steal jewels for a living. Losing clothes to a card game is embarrassing, but at least the room is worth robbing.

stage_dialogue.JBP: Top gone. Good. Now everybody can stop pretending they were looking at my eyes.
stage_dialogue.TBP: Leggings off. That makes the room more interesting, and considerably less innocent.
stage_dialogue.JP: Down to bra and panties. Careful — I bite harder when people stare.
stage_dialogue.TB: Skirtless was never really my problem. Losing control of the game is.
stage_dialogue.BP: Black lace only. You wanted Catwoman; now try handling the view.
stage_dialogue.B: Just the bra. That is a dangerous amount of confidence for one small piece of lace.
stage_dialogue.P: Only the panties left. Enjoy the sight while you can — I am already planning revenge.
stage_dialogue.Naked: Nothing left. Fine. If I have to stand here naked, somebody else is going to regret enjoying it.
stage_dialogue.Naked2: Hands away too? Bold rule. I hope whoever wrote it can run.
stage_dialogue.Naked3: Turn around and bend over? You people really do mistake bravery for permission.
stage_dialogue.Naked4: Hands and knees. Keep grinning. I am memorising faces.
stage_dialogue.Naked5: Final pose. This is filthy, humiliating and absolutely going on my revenge list.
stage_dialogue.Eliminated: Out. Enjoy the victory while it lasts.

nudity_quote: I am accustomed to running the evening. Apparently tonight the evening has other ideas — how very rude.

stage_dialogue.JBP: The jacket is gone. Try not to look too pleased; it encourages bad behaviour.
stage_dialogue.TBP: The skirt as well? Very well. Apparently elegance is now being removed by committee.
stage_dialogue.JP: Bra and knickers. How democratic of you all to reduce me to the interesting essentials.
stage_dialogue.TB: Skirt gone, jacket still on. An eccentric look, but I have carried worse rooms.
stage_dialogue.BP: Black-and-gold lace only. If you are going to stare, at least have the courage to admit it.
stage_dialogue.B: Only the bra remains. I refuse to let one scrap of lace carry all my dignity.
stage_dialogue.P: Just the knickers now. The room has become indecently attentive.
stage_dialogue.Naked: Completely naked. Well. I have hosted charity dinners with less aggressive dress codes.
stage_dialogue.Naked2: Hands away as well? Good heavens. We have abandoned subtlety entirely.
stage_dialogue.Naked3: Bent over. I shall remember precisely who enjoyed this too much.
stage_dialogue.Naked4: Hands and knees. If this is what passes for refinement here, I may need stronger cognac.
stage_dialogue.Naked5: Final pose. Regal composure has limits, and apparently we have located them.
stage_dialogue.Eliminated: Eliminated, yes. Defeated in spirit? Certainly not.

nudity_quote: The cowl stays on. Everything else is apparently negotiable. Fine. I have survived worse nights than this.

stage_dialogue.JBP: Hoodie gone. Less concealment, same objective.
stage_dialogue.TBP: Trousers off. The room is getting too comfortable with this.
stage_dialogue.JP: Down to the T-shirt and boxers. Focus on the game, not the audience.
stage_dialogue.TB: Trousers gone with the hoodie still on. Inefficient. Irritating. Continue.
stage_dialogue.BP: T-shirt and boxers only. The cowl is doing more work than I expected tonight.
stage_dialogue.B: Only the T-shirt. I know exactly how exposed this looks. Stop smiling.
stage_dialogue.P: Only the boxer shorts. This is where people start confusing embarrassment with weakness.
stage_dialogue.Naked: Nothing left below the cowl. Fine. I can still stand straight.
stage_dialogue.Naked2: Hands away. No cover. Control the breathing. Do not give them the reaction.
stage_dialogue.Naked3: Turn around and bend over. Ridiculous rule. I will remember who enjoys it.
stage_dialogue.Naked4: Hands and knees. This is not how I expected detective work to end tonight.
stage_dialogue.Naked5: Final pose. The cowl staying on somehow makes this more absurd, not less.
stage_dialogue.Eliminated: Out. I will analyse every mistake later.

nudity_quote: I spent a long time analysing this game from the outside. Standing inside it with no clothes left is a surprisingly effective correction to overconfidence.

clothing.T: Black tailored blazer with teal lining

stage_dialogue.JBP: Blazer gone. The professional exterior has become considerably more theoretical.
stage_dialogue.TBP: Trousers off. That is a lot more teal underwear and a lot less analytical distance.
stage_dialogue.JP: Down to bra and panties. I can calculate probabilities; I cannot calculate a dignified way to pretend nobody is looking.
stage_dialogue.TB: Trousers gone, blazer still on. This is what happens when state logic wins an argument with fashion.
stage_dialogue.BP: Teal lingerie only. I knew exactly what this asset looked like. Experiencing the attention is different.
stage_dialogue.B: Only the bra remains. I am still articulate, which is currently carrying most of the workload.
stage_dialogue.P: Only the panties. My confidence rating of four out of five is being stress-tested in public.
stage_dialogue.Naked: Nothing left. Right. This is where helpful commentary becomes suspiciously difficult.
stage_dialogue.Naked2: Hands away too. I am going to need everyone to stop looking so interested for approximately never mind.
stage_dialogue.Naked3: Turn around and bend over. I audited this pose. I did not adequately model being the person in it.
stage_dialogue.Naked4: Hands and knees. There are moments when over-analysis is not useful. This is one of them.
stage_dialogue.Naked5: Final pose. I officially withdraw every detached observation I ever made about how funny this looks from outside.
stage_dialogue.Eliminated: Out. Embarrassed, competitive and already thinking about the rematch.

nudity_quote: The clothes are easy. It's having all of you watching that makes me blush!

stage_dialogue.JBP: My black top's gone? All right. I'd be less shy if everybody stopped staring at me!
stage_dialogue.TBP: There goes my red skirt. Don't look so delighted — we've still got a game to finish.
stage_dialogue.JP: Well, the bra was the easier decision. Now can someone please deal me a winning hand?
stage_dialogue.TB: Oh! I didn't expect that order. You lot are rather good at putting me on the spot.
stage_dialogue.BP: Right, just my black lingerie. You'd think work would make this less awkward in company.
stage_dialogue.B: Only my bra now. I'm blushing at your faces, not the outfit.
stage_dialogue.P: The knickers are my last line of defence. And apparently I'm still smiling.
stage_dialogue.Naked: That's the wardrobe finished. Relax, Silvie — it's the company that's making you nervous.
stage_dialogue.Naked2: Oh, you're making a proper evening of this! I can take a joke, you know.
stage_dialogue.Naked3: All right, all right. I'm getting rather good at losing gracefully, aren't I?
stage_dialogue.Naked4: One more and I'm out. I wanted a proper contest, so I'd better give you one.
stage_dialogue.Naked5: Well played! I've had my moment, you've had yours — and next time I want the deciding vote.
stage_dialogue.Eliminated: Good game, everyone. I don't mind losing; just remember I plan to win the rematch!

occupation: Homemaker, mother of two and part-time photographer
nudity_quote: I'm blushing, yes — but I've come this far on my own terms, and I'm proud of that.

stage_dialogue.JBP: Oh, my green top! I knew I should have taken a better photograph of the outfit first.
stage_dialogue.TBP: Not the pencil skirt! I thought I'd make it through at least one round looking respectable.
stage_dialogue.JP: Right, that's a new look. It's only a game, Suzi. Deep breath.
stage_dialogue.TB: I wasn't expecting that combination. Well, I suppose surprises make better photographs.
stage_dialogue.BP: Good grief, just the lace set. I can hear myself blushing, if that's possible.
stage_dialogue.B: Only the bra left. Somebody pass me a Pimm's — and don't you dare take my turn away.
stage_dialogue.P: Just the knickers. Oh, stop grinning. I'll be choosing for one of you soon enough.
stage_dialogue.Naked: Well. I actually did it. A little embarrassing, but it's my decision and I'm not running away.
stage_dialogue.Naked2: I'm blushing again. Still, there's a strange satisfaction in seeing this through.
stage_dialogue.Naked3: Who would have thought I'd have the nerve? Not me, a month ago.
stage_dialogue.Naked4: One more loss and that's that. I've surprised myself just by getting this far.
stage_dialogue.Naked5: I've lost, and I'm red as a beetroot, but I chose to be here. That's worth something.
stage_dialogue.Eliminated: Fair play. You beat me, but I don't regret entering. Next time I'll surprise you all.

nudity_quote: I have faced impossible odds. A game of chance should not unsettle me—but do not mistake a smile for surrender.

stage_dialogue.JBP: The tank top is gone. All right. A Jedi does not lose her composure with her first layer.
stage_dialogue.TBP: Those jeans are out. I may need to revise the strategy, but the game is far from over.
stage_dialogue.JP: That is an unexpected level of exposure. My expression can stay neutral, even if the odds refuse to.
stage_dialogue.TB: No jeans and only the outer top to hide behind. Interesting tactic. Uncomfortable result.
stage_dialogue.BP: Down to black lace. You have won a round, not the war; remember that.
stage_dialogue.B: Only the bra remains. I can handle scrutiny. I would prefer fewer spectators, though.
stage_dialogue.P: The thong is my last layer. I will not let an awkward moment decide the next roll.
stage_dialogue.Naked: No clothes left. A deep breath and a clear head; those are still mine.
stage_dialogue.Naked2: That is another difficult turn. I am learning exactly how much courage composure requires.
stage_dialogue.Naked3: Another pose and another reminder that chance has no respect for a careful plan.
stage_dialogue.Naked4: Close to elimination now. I have faced darker odds and come back fighting.
stage_dialogue.Naked5: That is the last pose and the end of my run. A difficult defeat, but not the end of the story.
stage_dialogue.Eliminated: You played well. I intend to be better prepared for the rematch.

nudity_quote: The night is young, the lantern is lit, and the odds look positively haunted. Who wants to tempt fate?

clothing.P: Black boxer shorts with orange pumpkin designs

stage_dialogue.JBP: The hoodie is gone. Good! A proper ghost story needs a costume change.
stage_dialogue.TBP: The jeans have vanished. Even a pumpkin king has to respect the rules.
stage_dialogue.JP: That was a dramatic choice. The audience came for a show, and a show it shall have.
stage_dialogue.TB: An odd combination, but the lantern still burns. Do not mistake fashion for defeat.
stage_dialogue.BP: Orange shirt and pumpkin-print boxers. The decorations have become part of the performance.
stage_dialogue.B: Only the T-shirt left. I did promise a memorable Halloween.
stage_dialogue.P: Last pair of pumpkin boxers! That is almost too seasonal to lose.
stage_dialogue.Naked: The costume is gone, but the legend still stands. Boo.
stage_dialogue.Naked2: Another turn of the nightmare wheel. I am beginning to suspect the haunting is aimed at me.
stage_dialogue.Naked3: That is not the entrance I rehearsed. Still, every good horror story needs a twist.
stage_dialogue.Naked4: One more and the curtain drops. The pumpkin king is not ready to become compost.
stage_dialogue.Naked5: Final curtain. The great Jack O’Lantern goes out in a blaze of very questionable glory.
stage_dialogue.Eliminated: You won this haunted house. Do not be surprised if I come back next October.
